user.title: Solar Touch Setup
user.description: Choose where Home Assistant should read inverter data.

select_inverter.title: Select Your Inverter
select_inverter.description:
Multiple inverters found. Please select which one to monitor.

Note: The ID shown (e.g., ABCDE123456789) matches the serial number printed on your inverter device.

direct.title: Check Inverter IP Address
direct.description: Enter the inverter IP, Modbus/TCP port (usually 502), and unit ID (usually 1). Submit to test a read-only inverter register before saving. The default collection interval is 180 seconds. Ten-second polling can interrupt cloud uploads and turn the datalogger light red; quiet windows are only a precaution.

direct_confirm.title: Modbus Read Succeeded
direct_confirm.description: Home Assistant read register 0x1001 from {host}:{port} (unit {unit_id}); the raw value was {register_value}. This confirms the IP, port, and unit answer a read-only Modbus request. Submit to finish setup; the first full capture will then check sensor data.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to CloudInverter.net. Please check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid username or password. Please check your credentials and try again.
error.no_inverters: No inverters found in your account. Please add an inverter to your CloudInverter.net account first.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the logs and try again.
error.invalid_direct_host: Enter the inverter's LAN IP address, a valid port, and a Modbus unit ID from 0 to 255.
error.cannot_read_direct: Could not read the inverter over Modbus/TCP. Check its IP, port, unit ID, LAN access, and PV9000 compatibility.

init.description: Change the inverter LAN IP, Modbus/TCP port, unit ID, or collection interval for direct mode. Cloud mode changes the API refresh interval.
